# Third-party code, icons and fonts used by LockedIn

These files are hosted on our own site, so visitors' browsers don't contact other companies to load them.
The full license text for each one is in the `licenses` folder next to this file, as the licenses require.

| What | Where it's used | License | Full text |
|---|---|---|---|
| supabase-js 2.57.4 (database and sign-in library), installed from npm | built into the files in `/_next/static/` | MIT License, Copyright (c) 2020 Supabase | `licenses/supabase-js-MIT.txt` |
| Schibsted Grotesk font by Schibsted | `fonts/schibsted-grotesk-*.woff2` | SIL Open Font License 1.1, Copyright 2023 The Schibsted-Grotesk Project Authors | `licenses/schibsted-grotesk-OFL.txt` |
| JetBrains Mono font by JetBrains | `fonts/jetbrains-mono-*.woff2` | SIL Open Font License 1.1, Copyright 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors | `licenses/jetbrains-mono-OFL.txt` |
| Instrument Serif font by Instrument | `fonts/instrument-serif-*.woff2` | SIL Open Font License 1.1, Copyright 2022 The Instrument Serif Project Authors | `licenses/instrument-serif-OFL.txt` |
| Next.js (the framework that builds the website), installed from npm | built into the files in `/_next/static/` | MIT License, Copyright (c) 2025 Vercel, Inc. | `licenses/nextjs-MIT.txt` |
| React (draws the page), installed from npm | built into the files in `/_next/static/` | MIT License, Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates | `licenses/react-MIT.txt` |
| Settings (gear) icon, adapted from Feather Icons | inside the app's code | MIT License, Copyright (c) 2013-2023 Cole Bemis | `licenses/feather-icons-MIT.txt` |

The font files were downloaded from Google Fonts (latin and latin-ext subsets only). None of these fonts has a Reserved Font Name.
The SIL Open Font License allows using, copying and redistributing the fonts with software, but not selling the fonts on their own.

Everything else in LockedIn (the code, the other icons, the app icon, the screenshot on the front page and all the text) was made for LockedIn.
Discord and the Discord logo are trademarks of Discord Inc., used only to show that you sign in with Discord.
